lines.text: The quarterly inspection of the harbour warehouse began on a windy Tuesday morning. Inspectors
measured the loading docks, counted forty-two pallets of ceramic tiles, and recorded every serial number
in a battered blue notebook. By noon the crew had finished the eastern wing, while the cold storage room
still waited for its turn. The final report will list seventeen defects, from a cracked window to a missing fire
extinguisher.
Later the supervisor walked the yard with a clipboard, checking each stack of timber against the delivery
notes. Rain began after lunch, so the tarpaulins were pulled over the paint drums, and the last forklift was
parked beside the gate before the evening shift arrived.

lines.text: Harbour Warehouse Audit
This report summarises the yearly audit of the harbour warehouse. It was compiled from site visits,
counted inventory, and interviews with the loading crew.
1 Introduction
The warehouse stores ceramic tiles, timber boards, and sealed paint drums for three regional builders.
Goods arrive by truck in the early morning and leave by sea before the evening tide. The audit checks
whether every pallet can be found, whether the fire doors close, and whether the records match the
shelves.
1.1 Scope
Four areas were inspected: the loading docks, the eastern wing, the cold storage room, and the open yard.
Offices and the staff canteen were left out because they hold no stock. The main goals of the audit were:
Count every pallet and compare the total with the ledger
Test each fire door and emergency light
Photograph every damaged crate
Interview the night shift supervisor

Harbour Warehouse Audit
This report summarises the yearly audit of the harbour warehouse. It was compiled from site visits, counted inventory, and interviews with the loading crew.
1 Introduction

The warehouse stores ceramic tiles, timber boards, and sealed paint drums for three regional builders. Goods arrive by truck in the early morning and leave by sea before the evening tide. The audit checks whether every pallet can be found, whether the fire doors close, and whether the records match the shelves.
1.1 Scope

Four areas were inspected: the loading docks, the eastern wing, the cold storage room, and the open yard. Offices and the staff canteen were left out because they hold no stock. The main goals of the audit were:
Count every pallet and compare the total with the ledger
Test each fire door and emergency light
Photograph every damaged crate
Interview the night shift supervisor

lines.text: 4 Results
Figure 1 shows how the daily count changed during the audit week. Counts rose steadily on Monday and
Tuesday and settled on Wednesday.
Figure 1: Daily pallet count during the audit week.
No pallet was lost. Eleven labels were torn, three crates were cracked, and one fire door stuck in its frame.

lines.text: 5 Conclusion
The warehouse is in good order. The recommended actions are listed below.
Replace the sticking fire door in the eastern wing
Print new labels for the eleven torn pallets
Repair the three cracked crates before shipping
Repeat the count in the cold storage room next spring
The next audit is planned for the same week next year.

lines.text: Die Prüfung der Lagerhalle im Hafen begann an einem windigen
Dienstagmorgen. Die Prüfer maßen die Laderampen, zählten
zweiundvierzig Paletten mit Keramikfliesen und notierten jede
Seriennummer in einem abgegriffenen blauen Notizbuch. Bis
zum Mittag war der Ostflügel fertig, während der Kühlraum
noch warten musste. Der Abschlussbericht nennt siebzehn
Mängel, vom gesprungenen Fenster bis zum fehlenden
Feuerlöscher.

blocks.text: Die Prüfung der Lagerhalle im Hafen begann an einem windigen Dienstagmorgen. Die Prüfer maßen die Laderampen, zählten zweiundvierzig Paletten mit Keramikfliesen und notierten jede Seriennummer in einem abgegriffenen blauen Notizbuch. Bis zum Mittag war der Ostflügel fertig, während der Kühlraum noch warten musste. Der Abschlussbericht nennt siebzehn Mängel, vom gesprungenen Fenster bis zum fehlenden Feuerlöscher.
